stops.title: Classification, preparation & Finkelstein/Swarts reactions
stops.inShort: Vinylic halide: X attached to sp² carbon of C=C (CH₂=CH-X). Finkelstein (R-X + NaI/acetone → R-I); Swarts (R-Br + AgF/Hg₂F₂ → R-F). Sandmeyer reaction converts diazonium salts to aryl halides.

stops.title: Optical isomerism, SN1 & SN2 mechanisms
stops.inShort: SN2: bimolecular, single-step, backside attack, 100% inversion of configuration, order 1° > 2° > 3°. SN1: unimolecular, two-step via carbocation, racemization, order 3° > 2° > 1°.

stops.title: Reactions with KCN/AgCN, KNO₂/AgNO₂, Mg & Haloarenes
stops.inShort: R-X + KCN → R-CN (cyanide); R-X + AgCN → R-NC (isocyanide). R-X + AgNO₂ → R-NO₂ (nitroalkane). Wurtz-Fittig: R-X + Ar-X + 2Na → Ar-R + 2NaX.

items.f: R-X + KCN → R-CN;  R-X + AgCN → R-NC

board.text: (a) Write salient features of SN² mechanism. (b) What is the action of following reagents on bromomethane: (i) bromobenzene (ii) mercurous fluoride.
board.answer:
(a) SN² mechanism: Single-step concerted bimolecular reaction (rate = k[R-X][Nu⁻]); backside attack by nucleophile; 100% inversion of configuration (Walden inversion); reactivity 1° > 2° > 3°.
(b) (i) Wurtz-Fittig reaction: CH₃Br + C₆H₅Br + 2Na --(dry ether)--> C₆H₅-CH₃ (toluene) + 2NaBr.
(ii) Swarts reaction: 2CH₃Br + Hg₂F₂ → 2CH₃F (fluoromethane) + Hg₂Br₂.

points.text: Salient features of SN² (single step, rate law, inversion, 1°>2°>3°)

board.text: Among the following vinylic halide is ____.
board.answer: (b) CH₂=CH−X (halogen directly bonded to sp² carbon of C=C).

board.text: Complete the reaction: CH₃CH₂Cl --(AgCN, alc. Δ)--> ?
board.answer: CH₃CH₂Cl + AgCN --(alc. Δ)--> CH₃CH₂NC (ethyl isocyanide) + AgCl.

board.text: What is the action of following on ethyl bromide? (a) silver nitrite (b) Mg in dry ether (c) alcoholic sodium hydroxide.
board.answer:
(a) C₂H₅Br + AgNO₂ → C₂H₅NO₂ (nitroethane) + AgBr.
(b) C₂H₅Br + Mg --(dry ether)--> C₂H₅MgBr (ethyl magnesium bromide).
(c) C₂H₅Br + alc. NaOH --(Δ)--> CH₂=CH₂ (ethene) + NaBr + H₂O.
